training_policy: Legacy or repaired representation only; all other optimizer settings identical.

dataset.transformation: Treatment only: raw ? and ! become . before unchanged legacy normalization; quotes still become spaces; same51-character vocabulary.
dataset.raw_source_hash_definition: SHA256 of exact complete source segment after outer whitespace strip, before any other normalization.
dataset.source_id_definition: official_train or official_validation, colon, raw_source_sha256; source_index is zero-based complete segment index.
dataset.test_access: Sealed normalized test files; training workers must not read them. Freeze both model selections before final scoring.
